Looking at this qlang documentation and the tasks, I need to write queries that work with the given input files. Let me work through each task systematically.

Key concepts I'm using:
- `/path` for reading map keys and array indices
- `filter ~(...)` for filtering with conditions
- `map ~(...)` for transforming elements
- `allOf` for multiple conditions
- `:name value` to bind values
- Soft reads with `at` that return null if missing
- Common verbs like `count`, `sum`, `avg`, `sort`, `groupBy`, etc.

T1: Count users who are active AND have non-null email ending with @example.com (case-insensitive)
T2: Get admin role users, extract names, sort by lowercase
T3: Count users per country (handle missing/null as "unknown")
T4: Average age of users with non-null age, rounded to 2 decimals
T5: Lowercase labels from open issues, deduplicate and sort
T6: Top 3 issues by comments desc then number asc, with specific fields
T7: Count open issues per assignee login
T8: Merge dependencies, filter entries starting with "^", format as "name@version"
T9: Services with enabled=true and port > 8000, lowercase names, join with comma
T10: Count ERROR log lines per service
T11: Extract and average ms=<int> values from logs
T12: Sum of qty*price for shipped orders, skip empty prices
T13: Top 2 customers by total spend, excluding cancelled orders
T14: Process word list - lowercase, deduplicate, sort by length then alphabetically

T1: /data/users | filter ~(allOf /active (/email | ne null) (/email | lower | endsWith "@example.com")) | count
T2: /data/users | filter ~(/roles | map ~(lower) | contains "admin") | map /name | sort ~(lower)
T3: /data/users | groupBy ~(at /profile | coalesce {} | at /country | coalesce "unknown") | map ~(count)
T4: /data/users | map ~(at /profile | coalesce {} | at /age) | filter ~(ne null) | avg | round 2
T5: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | map /labels | flat | map ~(/name | lower) | distinct | sort
T6: sort ~([(/comments | desc) /number]) | take 3 | map ~({:number /number :assignee (at /assignee | at /login)})
T7: filter ~(allOf (/state | eq "open") (/assignee | ne null)) | groupBy ~(/assignee/login) | map ~(count)
T8: :deps /dependencies | :devDeps /devDependencies | (:deps | union :devDeps) | entries | filter ~(/1 | startsWith "^") | sort ~(/0) | map ~([/0 "@" /1] | join "")
T9: /services | filter ~(allOf (/enabled | coalesce false) (/port | gt 8000)) | map ~(/name | lower) | sort | join ","
T10: lines | filter ~(split " " | /1 | eq "ERROR") | map ~(split " " | /2) | groupBy ~(/) | map ~(count)
T11: lines | map ~(split " " | filter ~(startsWith "ms=") | first) | filter ~(ne null) | map ~(split "=" | /1) | map ~(parseJson) | avg | round 1
T12: lines | drop 1 | map ~(split ",") | filter ~(allOf (/5 | lower | eq "shipped") (/4 | ne "")) | map ~({:qty (/3 | parseJson) :price (/4 | parseJson)} | mulOf /qty /price) | sum | round 2
T13: lines | drop 1 | map ~(split ",") | filter ~(allOf (/5 | lower | ne "cancelled") (/4 | ne "")) | map ~({:customer /1 :amount ({:qty (/3 | parseJson) :price (/4 | parseJson)} | mulOf /qty /price)}) | groupBy ~(/customer) | map ~(map /amount | sum) | entries | sort ~(/1 | desc) | take 2 | map ~({:customer /0 :total (/1 | round 2)})
T14: ["Banana","apple","Cherry","banana","fig","APPLE","date","kiwi","Fig","elderberry"] | map ~(lower) | distinct | sort ~([(count | desc) /]) | join "-"
